title: Quantity
description: Traits of the widgets showing a physical quantity (API-005, UNIT-001 .. UNIT-017). The host passes numbers in input_unit; the front end converts them into the displayed unit.

value.description: Current value, in input_unit; null: no value received yet, shown as such rather than as zero (ROB-002).

min.description: Lower end of the scale, in input_unit.

max.description: Upper end of the scale, in input_unit.

unit.description: Displayed unit, whatever the unit system; empty: the unit the unit system assigns to the quantity (UNIT-002, UNIT-003).

input_unit.description: Unit of value, min, max and limits; empty: the metric unit of the quantity (UNIT-010).
